discord._follow: Discord members to follow, by priority (id, username or display name): the bot joins their voice channel and follows them when they move. Nobody in voice: voiceChannelId.

_target: 'our-team': only players of the team with at least one player from players. 'everyone': both teams. Can be changed while the bot is running.
_players: Spoken name -> in-game names (one player can have several accounts: they count as one). Case, accents, spaces and punctuation don't matter, and a name cut short by the game (8 characters or more) is recognized: MonSuperPseudo2000 = MonSuperPséudo20. These players define our team. Can be changed while the bot is running.
_opponentNames: What the voice says instead of an opponent's name (one drawn at random). The Discord posts keep the real names.
_pronunciation: Words replaced right before the voice, so that it says them correctly. Can be changed while the bot is running.
_voice: provider: "edge" (free Microsoft voices, list) or "openai" (paid, openai.voices, key in openai.apiKey or the OPENAI_API_KEY variable). rotation: "line" (each line always has the same voice, the voices still change from one line to the next: needed for the voice library), "random", "alternate" or "fixed" (always the first). jingle: true (ding before each line), false, or the path of your own sound. Can be changed while the bot is running, except the volume.

openai.instructions: Tu es un commentateur sportif français, moqueur et piquant. Parle en français de France, avec un ton ironique et vivant.

_pregenerate: Voice library: every line (players, opponentNames) is generated in advance, so it plays without waiting. With the free voices the missing ones are made in the background at launch; with paid voices, only with npm run pregenerate (which shows the cost first).
_recordMatches: Records every match in matches/ (replayable with --replay), with the bot's comments in it.
_rules: Rules switched on (true) or off (false), by family or one by one (e.g. "giveaway.ofTheMatch": false). A rule that is off is not detected at all: no voice, no post, nothing in the recap. See REGLES.md. Can be changed while the bot is running.
_thresholds: Detection thresholds (see REGLES.md). Distances in game units (100 = 1 m), speeds in km/h, durations in ms. Can be changed while the bot is running; npm run calibrate suggests values from your votes.
_rocketLeague: checkApi: at launch then every 10 min, sets PacketSendRate back to the right value in DefaultStatsAPI.ini (Steam and Epic found automatically; gamePaths to add an install folder by hand).
